Rent a pink bike anytime you want. Ride for as long as you need. Then lock it anywhere within the designated area for the next rider. This is proper bikesharing!

How can I rent a bike?
You can easily register just on the street or you can use the account you already created in the past. To start a ride, scan a QR code on the basket of the bike and the bike lock will open automatically. You are ready to go!

How much does it cost?
It depends on the city – prices start at around 1 EUR per ride. You can get an unlimited number of rides for up to 30 minutes with a Rekola subscription. The app will always show you the current price. Or just take a look at www.rekola.cz/en for the pricing.

Where and when is possible to rent a bike? And how can I return it?
You can rent Rekola bikes 24/7. Simply pick the bike on the street, unlock it via the app, and ride. During your rental, you can bike and park in bike racks anywhere in the city. When ending your rental, the bike must be locked and returned within the pink area (the zone) shown on the map.
